cues: By the stream they find a dead Chinese man, face down, in blue, beside a spade, a heap of stones and a freshly dug hole.
Evans swears and stamps; Hooker turns white and notices the dead man's neck is puffed and purple, his hands swollen.
Then Hooker looks into the hole: You fool, it's all right.
text: By the stream they find a dead Chinese man, face down, in blue, beside a spade, a heap of stones and a freshly dug hole. Somebody has been here before. Evans swears and stamps; Hooker turns white and notices the dead man's neck is puffed and purple, his hands swollen. Then Hooker looks into the hole: You fool, it's all right. It's here still. Dull yellow bars of gold.
